This template (uploaded without license tag) is used to tag files uploaded (but not by using the basic form apparently). Usually [[:User:Nikbot]] (it ignores this template) will come by after some time and add a {{tl|no license since}} and inform the uploader. This template is added (substed) by UW (but not by the basic upload form) for uploads without a license: {{tl|Remove this line and insert a license instead}} with time parameters filled in (see below). Files are categorized in [[:Category:Media uploaded without a license]] *Current ({{ISOdate|2011-11-25}}) discussion: [[Commons_talk:Upload_Wizard#New UW version deployed (Multi-file selection and more)]] * {{see also cat|Media uploaded without a license|banner=no}} [[Category:Problem tags|{{PAGENAME}}]] This is added to files:
{{{Remove this line and insert a license instead|year={{subst:CURRENTYEAR}}|month={{subst:CURRENTMONTH}}|day={{subst:CURRENTDAY2}}}}
